stories.headline: RAF Fairford incident involves 'foreign actor', says Rubio
stories.description: In a television interview the US secretary of state mentioned Iran, which has denied any involvement.

stories.headline: Why has Putin added 15,000 new soldiers to Russia’s army?
stories.description: The move marks the fourth military expansion this year as Russia’s war in Ukraine seemingly stalls.

stories.headline: Indian firm building $15bn Trump-announced steel mill has deep Russia ties
stories.description: Russian cash helped Essar, the firm behind the steel factory, manage major debts. Now the group’s investing in the US.

stories.headline: Israeli settlers attack West Bank village and block Palestinian family's return home
stories.description: Two homes belonging to the al-Tubasi family were set on fire and Israeli security forces were also targeted by settlers.

stories.headline: Estonia says Russia ordered August arson attack on defence company
stories.description: Estonia accuses Moscow of an arson attack on Milrem Robotics, a defence supplier to Ukraine.
